key.name: wallpaper-directory
key.description: Folder whose images are shown in the picker. When empty, ~/Pictures/Wallpapers (the localized Pictures folder) is used.

key.name: show-picker
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens (or closes) the full-screen wallpaper picker.

key.name: next-wallpaper
key.description: Optional keyboard shortcut that applies the next image in the wallpaper folder, wrapping around.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Border color of the focused wallpaper in the picker, as #RRGGBB.
